subject: Taxes
title: Filing Status Matters
description: A quick, practical guide to Filing Status Matters.

hook.text: Are you single, married, or head of household? Your filing status changes your tax brackets, deductions.

buildup.text: Married couples filing jointly get double the standard deduction and wider tax brackets. Marriage has real tax benefits.

discovery.text: Head of household status—for single parents—gets better rates than single filers.

twist.text: The 'marriage penalty' hits some high-earning couples: joint filing pushes combined income into higher brackets.

climax.text: Filing status can change your tax bill by thousands of dollars. Choosing the right one isn't a detail—it's a decision.

punchline.text: Single, married, or head of household. Status alone shifts thousands.

quiz.question: What is the 'marriage penalty' in taxation?
options: Some couples pay more tax married than filing as singles
